article.headline: No. 12 Vanderbilt women beat Oregon State 71-60
article.description: — Mia Woolfolk scored 22 points for No. 12 Vanderbilt, and the Commodores pulled away in the second quarter to beat Oregon State 71-60 on Wednesday night in the Jacksonville Classic.
article.linkText: No. 12 Vanderbilt women beat Oregon State 71-60
article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Mia Woolfolk scored 22 points for No. 12 Vanderbilt, and the Commodores pulled away in the second quarter to beat Oregon State 71-60 on Wednesday night in the Jacksonville Classic. Vanderbilt ended the first quarter trailing 20-17 but outscored Oregon State 22-8 in the second for a 39-28 halftime lead. Mikayla Blakes scored seven points in the second quarter and Woolfolk and Madison Greene added six points apiece. Woolfolk was 7 of 11 from the floor and 8 of 10 from the free-throw line. Olivia Jones made two 3-pointers and finished with 16 points for Vanderbilt (7-1). Woolfolk and Jones each grabbed eight of the Commodores' 39 rebounds. Blakes scored 13 points with four steals for Vanderbilt. Aiyana Mitchell blocked four shots and had six rebounds, two assists and two steals but missed her only shot attempt. Jenna Villa hit five 3-pointers and scored 17 points for Oregon State (4-4). Maggie Warpus added 15 points with three 3s. The Beavers hit 10 shots from distance but had 19 turnovers. Vanderbilt is 5-0 against Oregon State in the series that dates to the 1989-90 season. Up next Vanderbilt: hosts Georgia State on Sunday.
